retainedFollowUps.title: Implement script toggle (繁體/簡體 content switching)
retainedFollowUps.startCondition: Product owner activates script toggle feature
retainedFollowUps.stopCondition: Toggle switches all learner-facing Chinese content between Traditional (zh-Hant) and Simplified (zh-Hans) characters, including: examples.traditional/examples.simplified, coreSentence (paired field in lesson data), chunks[].chunk, kanjiBridgeNotes[].kanji, and any Chinese text rendered on the home page, GoalPathSlot, and lesson page. Displayed text, lang attribute, renderer output, and persisted preference stay in sync. Lesson-level Chinese fields that do not yet have paired traditional/simplified forms require narrow-scope schema changes to be defined in the implementing issue.
retainedFollowUps.benefit: Single-script learners can read content in their preferred script without separate routes.
